# Angular HttpClient fixture

Independent sourceRoot projects exercise receiver DI proof, every method form,
wrapper overrides, functional/class/test/conditional registrations and unresolved
bases. The loose directory has no matching Angular project. The shadow package manifest uses an inert name for the initial run.

No live ignore files or ignored directory names are used; no ignore-file/directory
remapping is needed. environment.prod changes only the origin. Duplicate Express cases
cover identical handlers/middleware, differing handlers, differing middleware,
and different router objects.

The test renames shadow/_package.json to package.json only for a second replay
that proves workspace shadowing; baseline uses external Angular exports.

revision3 is indexed separately with its own golden. It adds an opaque rewrite
and an unevaluable prefix in distinct projects with namespaced routes. Keeping
this repository separate preserves the original loose (unowned) call's outcome:
an unowned call must consider every production registration in its repository.
Revision 3 also checks missing/malformed ownership and configuration replay.
